Elizabeth Veldon.title: on margate sands i can connect nothing with nothing
Elizabeth Veldon.about:
SundayElizabeth Veldon
elizabeth Veldon is a (sometime Harsh) Noise Artist who is influenced by Abstract Art, Minimalism and the Avant Guards as much as by the pull of fucking loud noises. Her music is not meant to be taken too seriously but is sometimes deadly serious.
elizabeth has been making music in one form or another for over five years and has moved from early Tape Music and processed guitars towards using found sound, samples, loops and sine waves.
elizabeth's music is entirely synthetic and she makes no apology for that.
This album is based on T S Eliot's 'The Wasteland'.
